matches.title: Brightwater district profile (2025)
matches.text: Brightwater has 17 schools, which enrolled 6,241 pupils for the 2025/26 school year. The district, founded in 1889, stretches along the Bright over 912.4 square kilometres and keeps 455.0 km of paved road.

corrections.title: Correction notice - Brightwater
corrections.text: Correction: the 2025 Brightwater district profile gives the district's area as 912.4 square kilometres. This is a transposition error.

corrections.title: Correction notice - Brightwater
corrections.text: The correct area is 921.4 square kilometres. All other figures in that profile are correct.

matches.title: Millbrook district profile (2025)
matches.text: The district, founded in 1897, stretches along the Mill Brook over 758.6 square kilometres and keeps 360.1 km of paved road. Census population: 34,590 in 2020 and 37,203 in 2025.

matches.title: Millbrook district profile (2025)
matches.text: Census population: 34,590 in 2020 and 37,203 in 2025. Households used 2,806 megalitres of water during 2025, and the district's 2025 budget amounted to 6,305.7 million tenge.

matches.title: Millbrook district profile (2025)
matches.text: Millbrook has 15 schools, which enrolled 5,562 pupils for the 2025/26 school year. The district, founded in 1897, stretches along the Mill Brook over 758.6 square kilometres and keeps 360.1 km of paved road.
